title: Integral
summary: An integral aggregates local quantities according to a declared notion of size.

content.plain: An integral aggregates local quantities according to a declared notion of size.
content.exact: For a Riemann-integrable f on [a,b], ∫ₐᵇf is the common limit of refining upper/lower or tagged sums; Lebesgue integration uses measures and simple-function limits.
content.caveat: Riemann, Lebesgue, stochastic, path, and other integrals are not one unqualified operation.
